support.empty: Group crew and family tags with OR inside a group and AND across groups, e.g. (Straw Hat Pirates or Heart Pirates) and (Dressrosa).
support.all: Showing characters that match every tag group.
support.any: Showing characters that match at least one tag group.

superTandemPresence.support: Show only characters with structured Super Tandem data.

superTypesClassesPresence.support: Show only characters with structured Super Type or Super Class data.

support.empty: One button, every kind of ability filter: captain, special, crewmate, potential and support. Group them with OR inside a group and AND across groups.
support.active: Showing characters that match every ability group. Reopen the filter to edit or remove a group.

sections.captainAbility: Abilities the character must carry as a Captain Ability. Counts here are captain-only, so they are smaller than the crew-wide ones.
sections.special: Abilities from the character's activated special.
sections.crewmate: Sailor abilities the character has while it fights as a crewmate.
sections.potential: Potential abilities, including Super Tandem, Final Tap and Rush Sugo effects.
sections.support: Abilities the character grants to the crewmate it supports.
